subject.title: feat(webchat): lobster pet shape variants (build, claw size, tail fan)

question: Should the web UI lobster pet continue expanding in core with seeded shape variants for build, claw size, and tail fan?
rationale: The patch looks technically coherent, but this is user-facing mascot/design polish in core and the protected maintainer label requires explicit maintainer handling before merge.

options.title: Accept Shape Variants
options.body: Land the focused visual expansion after exact-head CI because it extends the already-accepted sidebar lobster pet without config or behavior surface.

options.title: Narrow The Visual Scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller subset of traits if maintainers want the mascot to stay visually simpler while preserving the existing pet behavior.

options.title: Pause Core Mascot Expansion
options.body: Close or defer this follow-up if the current lobster pet catalog is enough for core and future variants should wait for a broader product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept Shape Variants
recommendation.body: Land the focused visual expansion after exact-head CI because it extends the already-accepted sidebar lobster pet without config or behavior surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the predecessor lobster pet work and is the strongest routing owner for this design decision.
